draft.body:
Thanks for connecting. Like I mentioned, I came across the New College Grad Embedded Firmware Engineer opening at Micron in Boise and thought my background could be a good fit for the team.

I have hands on experience programming STM32 peripherals directly in bare metal C at the register level, including GPIO, timers, and I2C, without any HAL or RTOS abstraction. I have also designed and fabricated my own PCBs in EAGLE, implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback, and spent time debugging full hardware and software systems end to end through real integration issues across sensors, servos, and firmware.

If you think it could be a fit and you are open to it, I would really appreciate a referral for the role. Happy to send my resume over whenever works for you.
draft.hook_used: Connection request accepted; this is the substantive ask that follows, not a stale follow up. Senior HBM Design Engineer at Micron, hardware/design background overlaps with PCB and register level firmware experience
